title: Governance
learning_outcomes: Explain institutional arrangements in the context of governance.
Compare and distinguish public authority in the context of governance.
Apply policy implementation in the context of governance.
Evaluate and justify decisions about civic participation in the context of governance.

lessons.title: Institutional arrangements
lessons.outcome: Explain institutional arrangements in the context of governance.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving institutional arrangements; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to institutional reform memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain institutional arrangements from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of institutional arrangements; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Public authority
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish public authority in the context of governance.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving public authority; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to institutional reform memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain public authority from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of public authority; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Policy implementation
lessons.outcome: Apply policy implementation in the context of governance.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving policy implementation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to institutional reform memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain policy implementation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of policy implementation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Civic participation
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about civic participation in the context of governance.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving civic participation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to institutional reform memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain civic participation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of civic participation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of institutional arrangements; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of public authority; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of policy implementation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of civic participation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Historian, economist, legal or policy specialist as appropriate.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
